学生甲 · 本次口语作业反馈
（2026-09-26 · 自拟练习 Speaking Part 1（体育与课外活动））

## 一、你这次做到的三件事

1. 五道题全部答完，没有空题。第一题主动给了理由：I usually play basketball with my friends after school。
2. 念题那段吐字清楚，句尾该升的升、该降的降。
3. 最后一题连着说了两句原因，愿意把想法铺开一点。

## 三、逐句修改（只列最值得改的 5 句）

| # | 你说的 | 改后 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | I play basketball since I am ten years old | I have played basketball since I was ten years old | 讲"从过去持续到现在"的事要用现在完成时 |
| 2 | Last summer I go to the beach with my family | Last summer I went to the beach with my family | 过去的事要用过去式 |
| 3 | I didn't went to the new sports centre | I didn't go to the new sports centre | didn't 后面要用动词原形 |
| 4 | My brother like basketball too | My brother likes basketball too | 第三人称单数要加 s |
| 5 | Yes I do | Yes I do, because I usually play it at the weekend | 不要只回一句话，补一个理由 |

## 四、可以直接背的三句升级表达

1. I have played basketball since I was ten years old.
2. The sport I like has changed a lot since I was little.
3. I have never been to a big sports centre, but I would love to.

## 五、下次课当场验收的一件事

每道题至少说两句，第二句必须带 because。做到就当场给肯定。
